plugin_description: Connect an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and manage its model catalog.
provider_hint: Discover models from the endpoint, choose which ones are enabled, and declare each model's capabilities. After a restart, the first enabled model becomes the host's current chat model.
configured_placeholder: Configured; enter a new value to replace it
status_unconfigured: Provider credentials or enabled models are incomplete
api_key_configured: A key is stored. Leave blank to keep it.
api_key_hint: Required before models can be discovered.
models_hint: {enabled} enabled of {total} saved models. Saved changes are applied after the server restarts.
no_models_hint: Discover models from the endpoint or add a model id manually.
custom_capabilities_hint: Comma-separated tags other plugins can query, for example coding, structured-output.
default_model_hint: All enabled models are published to the plugin model catalog. After restart, the first enabled model is the current default.
duplicate_model: That model is already in the catalog
save_failed: Could not save the model catalog
